setup._note: NOT MEASURED, and deliberately so. The flow was built by adding actions by hand with typed-in values, not by recording a demonstration, so it is not the same task this project's system performs. A setup-time comparison would not be like-for-like and is not reported.

baseline_run._note: The flow fills one student's row on v0_base. Not a 50-row run.

after_ui_change._note: THIS IS THE RESULT. Same flow, unedited, pointed at each variant.

notes: Power Automate's auto-generated selector for the Remarks dropdown was 'tbody[Id="records-body"] > tr > td > select[Name="remarks"]'. The 'tr' has no row qualifier, so it matched all 50 rows and set every student to Passed in one action, with no error or warning - despite a unique id being present on the element that was captured.
Re-capturing the element regenerated the same ambiguous selector every time. Targeting a single row required editing the selector by hand.
